content.title: Stone Garden Carrier Relay | Shared World Chapters and Monumental Lockup
content.summary: An amber seed and paper flowers relay across adult archivists before revealing a basalt archive guardian. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One accent carrier color recurs through every chapter. + Every role change is bridged by a visible object, plant or bird handoff. + All chapters share one dark palette and compatible world physics. + The monumental reveal contains residues of the earlier carriers. + One exact original title appears only after the relay converges.
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult archivist reaches through indigo leaves and receives one luminous amber seed. The courier runs left to right through amber flowers under one storm-dark sky while the bowl stays intact. Reveal a monumental basalt librarian above the amber field and end on the exact original title THE SEED ARCHIVE.
required_anchors: One accent carrier color recurs through every chapter.
Every role change is bridged by a visible object, plant or bird handoff.
The monumental reveal contains residues of the earlier carriers.
One exact original title appears only after the relay converges.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An amber seed and paper flowers relay across adult archivists before revealing a basalt archive guardian. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 用一种高对比色载体在多名成年角色之间接力，让花、果实、器皿和鸟群把看似分散的章节绑定到同一世界；终局把全部载体痕迹汇聚到巨像与准确片名。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One accent carrier color recurs through every chapter.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One accent carrier color recurs through every chapter."

invariants.rule: Every role change is bridged by a visible object, plant or bird handoff.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every role change is bridged by a visible object, plant or bird handoff."

invariants.rule: All chapters share one dark palette and compatible world physics.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "All chapters share one dark palette and compatible world physics."

invariants.rule: The monumental reveal contains residues of the earlier carriers.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The monumental reveal contains residues of the earlier carriers."

invariants.rule: One exact original title appears only after the relay converges.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "One exact original title appears only after the relay converges."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
